A worked example of a customer page; not a customer. Status: **example**, a worked example; not a customer.

**A worked example.** The numbers on this page are invented to show the shape of a customer page. Nothing here describes a real person or organisation.

## What the brief asks us to track

**Started**
: 2026-10-01
**The agent**
: An assistant connected to a shared mailbox, read-only scope; nearest published shape: Gmail at read-only scope.
**First behaviour policy**
: 2026-10-04: 9 rows, 4 gaps
**Milestone steps done**
: 5 of 7
**Credit**
: £12 used of £50 granted; not topped up (invented numbers, to show the page)
**Follow-ups recorded**
: 2

## Objectives agreed with them

- Know what the mailbox assistant can reach before the quarterly review.
- Turn the two rules in the team's wiki into rows with a barrier each.

## The follow-up log

Each follow-up asks three things: what they did, what got in the way, and what is next. Newest first. The record here is the summary; anything private stays with the lead.

| Date | What they did | What got in the way | What is next |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-04 | Wrote the mandate; corrected two rows downward. | Nothing. | Read the delta and name the row that surprised them. |
| 2026-10-02 | Named the agent and read the nearest example. | Could not tell which scope the connector was granted. | Run the first try-it prompt to list the tools. |

**What is not on this page.** No contact details, no private notes, nothing the customer did not agree to show. The source is `data/customers.json`; a change to it is a release, so the history of this page is the history of the repository.
